propositions: config.local_to_jira_status is a third independent literal copy of LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA that is content-identical today but has no enforcement preventing future divergence
Mutation of config.local_to_jira_status["deleted"] to an invalid workflow value is not caught by any existing test, leaving the divergence path unguarded

A parity test using the existing _load_attr helper must assert full-dict equality between config.local_to_jira_status and the canonical LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA loaded from adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py
config.py must retain its zero-dependency property and not import from adapters/ to preserve the one-way dependency direction and the operator-override kill-switch surface
A lock-step comment must be added to config.local_to_jira_status mirroring the existing pattern on config.jira_to_local_status, naming the canonical map and the enforcing test
